run_socket_server: run the web app socket server on port 2557 to serve JSON responses from webapp_data.json
convert_dict_keys: recursively convert all dictionary keys to strings using the convert function
review_convert_function: review the convert function that recursively converts dictionary keys to strings
test_socket_server: test the socket server by sending a message and receiving the matching JSON response
refactor_socket_server: refactor the socket server to add hooks for custom message handling logic
